title: Versioned corpus + extraction release (Zenodo DOI + Datasheet + Croissant/BioC)
context: The corpus + extraction are released as a versioned, citable artifact with a Datasheet and Croissant/BioC export. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Mixed-license labeling must be correct per record, and a final license+PII sign-off confirms no ND full text or identifiable detail is present.
objective: Release the versioned corpus + extraction with a Zenodo DOI, Datasheet, and Croissant/BioC export.
acceptanceCriteria: Corpus + extraction released as a versioned, citable artifact (Zenodo DOI) with a Datasheet (motivation, composition, collection, license mix, PII stance, limitations) and Croissant/BioC export.
Mixed-license labeling correct per record; our added content CC-BY-4.0; code MIT; no ND full text or identifiable detail present (final license+PII sign-off recorded).
Eval report for the release attached (F1, kappa, groundedness pass rate).
